scientific_question: At a fixed budget of 200 outer iterations, how much of the useful spectral and topological result of the faithful Du-Olhoff trajectory has been obtained relative to its own k=1600 late-run reference?
primary_quality_metric: common E1 raw omega1 relative loss versus the same mesh at k=1600

quality_crossing_rule.first_crossing: earliest observed outer iteration with signed relative loss <= band
quality_crossing_rule.persistent_crossing: earliest observed outer iteration from which signed relative loss never exceeds the band through k=1600
quality_crossing_rule.evaluation_grid: every stored iteration for raw E1 omega1 when feasible; otherwise all evaluated checkpoints, explicitly labelled

modal_rules.persistent_entry: earliest iteration from which the condition remains true through k=1600

k200_classification.BIMODAL_ESTABLISHED: at k=200, N==2 and gap12<=0.01, and both conditions remain true at every subsequent observed iteration through k=1600
k200_classification.BIMODAL_TRANSIENT: at k=200, N==2 and gap12<=0.01, but either condition later fails before or at k=1600

adequacy_rule.STRICTLY_ADEQUATE: healthy, both representations connected, acceptable modal state, and common E1 raw omega1 loss <= 0.005
adequacy_rule.PRACTICALLY_ADEQUATE: healthy, both representations connected, acceptable modal state, and common E1 raw omega1 loss <= 0.01
adequacy_rule.COARSELY_ADEQUATE: healthy, both representations connected, and common E1 raw omega1 loss <= 0.025
adequacy_rule.INADEQUATE: common E1 raw omega1 loss > 0.025, or health/volume/connectivity failure, or the intended spectral state is materially missed
adequacy_rule.disclosure: E2, E3, and binary losses are always reported but do not silently replace the preregistered primary E1-raw rule

cross_resolution_rule.declared_criterion: PRACTICALLY_ADEQUATE (the 1.0% band), with all stricter/coarser results also disclosed
cross_resolution_rule.ROBUST_PRACTICAL_BUDGET: k=200 is PRACTICALLY_ADEQUATE on all four meshes
cross_resolution_rule.RESOLUTION_SENSITIVE_BUDGET: k=200 is PRACTICALLY_ADEQUATE on at least one but not all four meshes
cross_resolution_rule.INSUFFICIENT_BUDGET: k=200 is PRACTICALLY_ADEQUATE on none of the four meshes

design_distance.binary_topology_turnover: mean(xb(k) != xb(1600)) using exact-count volume-preserving binaries
design_distance.same_phase_reference: when a period-two signature is material, additionally compare k with the latest k<=1600 having the same iteration parity

cost.cumulative_loop_time: cumulative sum of measured per-iteration eigensolve, gradient, and LP-inner telemetry
cost.mean_time_per_iteration: measured cumulative loop time divided by checkpoint iteration
cost.window_time_per_iteration: mean measured loop time over the trailing min(50,k) iterations
cost.eigensolve_share: cumulative measured eigensolve time divided by cumulative measured loop time

forbidden: retune move, tolOuter, rmin, or tolMult
call k=200 or k=1600 converged without independent evidence
